name: Urayama kara Yakusou o Tottekita Hazu ga Biyaku Deshita
original_name: 裏山から薬草をとってきたハズが媚薬でした
source:
I brought some medicinal herbs to my childhood friend who’s bedridden with a cold!
Wait—what!? They weren’t medicinal herbs, but an aphrodisiac herb!?
Well, it can’t be helped… I’ll just have to make do with whatever’s in the house! …And that’s the story.
